_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, credit cost, expense, nonperforming-asset and pre-tax margin signals with JPMorgan Chase's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'JPMorgan Chase & Co. ... is a leading financial services firm based in the United States' 'Unfavorable market and economic conditions can have an adverse effect on JPMorgan Chase’s wholesale businesses.' 'JPMorgan Chase operates in a highly competitive environment in which it must evolve and adapt to the significant changes as a result of changes in financial regulation, technological advances, increased public scrutiny and changes in economic conditions.' (FY2020 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the word appears only in 'countercyclical capital buffer', a regulatory term: the LOW and SHW reading); among its competitors it lists 'e-commerce and other internet-based companies, financial technology companies', and it says 'both financial institutions and their non-banking competitors face the risk that payments processing and other services could be significantly disrupted by technologies, such as cryptocurrencies, that require no intermediation'; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and scoped to banks and payments: these words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for JPMorgan Chase

theme_watch.reason: Live: JPMorgan Chase's own FY2020 10-K says 'both financial institutions and their non-banking competitors face the risk that payments processing and other services could be significantly disrupted by technologies, such as cryptocurrencies, that require no intermediation'. The stock trades at 17.3x FY21E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CRYPTO) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing crypto disintermediation of JPMorgan Chase's payments and banking specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'JPMorgan Chase & Co. ... is a leading financial services firm based in the United States' 'Unfavorable market and economic conditions can have an adverse effect on JPMorgan Chase’s wholesale businesses.' 'JPMorgan Chase operates in a highly competitive environment in which it must evolve and adapt to the significant changes as a result of changes in financial regulation, technological advances, increased public scrutiny and changes in economic conditions.' (FY2020 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets and the economy, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the word appears only in 'countercyclical capital buffer', a regulatory term: the LOW and SHW reading); among its competitors it lists 'e-commerce and other internet-based companies, financial technology companies', and it says 'both financial institutions and their non-banking competitors face the risk that payments processing and other services could be significantly disrupted by technologies, such as cryptocurrencies, that require no intermediation'; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and scoped to banks and payments: these words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for JPMorgan Chase. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +92% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.87; conservative 2yr -12%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -17.2%/yr (worst year FY11-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +16.8%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.8%/yr (FY11-FY20 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY20, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: JPM (retrospective, 2021-04-30) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (68.7% downside to Bear $48.11 / -2.4% upside to Bull $150.16) | Adj composite 2.90 vs market 3.77: gap -0.87 [OVERVALUED] | +92% above the EPP floor $79.92 (9x FY21E $8.88) | Conservative 2-yr case: -11.5% total (-5.7%/yr) | At 17.3x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $203.41 sits above the BULL case; revenue +14.1% YoY in Q1 2021, forward revenues +14.1% (Q1 2021 revenue growth (no Q2 2021 guide)); crypto is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
